name: openadapt-agent
description: Governed local MCP bridge for compiled OpenAdapt workflows and attended decisions.
long_description: Inspect compiled workflows, run them through OpenAdapt's policy and verification gates, and resolve durable Needs Attention items. The server runs locally; workflow bundles and protected evidence stay on the operator's machine by default.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List PHI-safe projections of locally compiled OpenAdapt workflows.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Inspect one workflow's governed, PHI-safe capability summary.

tools.name: get_run_report
tools.description: Read a PHI-safe status and count summary for a run created by this server.

tools.name: list_needs_attention
tools.description: List durable workflow pauses that need an operator decision.

tools.name: get_attention_item
tools.description: Inspect one PHI-safe Needs Attention item and its allowed actions.

bundles_dir.title: Workflow bundles
bundles_dir.description: Choose a compiled OpenAdapt bundle or a directory containing bundles. The files stay on this machine.

runs_dir.title: Run evidence
runs_dir.description: Directory for local reports, durable pauses, and protected evidence.

allow_run.title: Allow governed workflow runs
allow_run.description: Add run tools. Every run still passes OpenAdapt's admission, identity, policy, and effect-verification gates.

allow_attended_actions.title: Allow Needs Attention decisions
allow_attended_actions.description: Add Teach and Escalate. A qualified deployment config also enables Continue and Skip with live revalidation.

deployment_config.title: Qualified deployment config
deployment_config.description: Optional OpenAdapt deployment YAML used for live Continue and Skip verification.

headed.title: Show the attended browser
headed.description: Keep a deployment-configured browser visible while resolving attended pauses.

bundle_key.title: Bundle decryption key
bundle_key.description: Optional key for an encrypted-at-rest workflow bundle.
